notes.title: BrokenLore: DON'T WATCH - RELEASE DATE ANNOUCEMENT
notes.notes:
We're super excited to share that BrokenLore: DON'T WATCH, the next chapter in the BrokenLore series, is coming to Steam on March 20th, 2025!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2351330/BrokenLore_DONT_WATCH/
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215569/68e0454c875a4fbef737b42e49a3e544f601912d.png

This time, we're diving into the tough subject of social anxiety, with Shinji as our main character. He’s a young hikikomori, living in isolation in his Tokyo apartment, struggling with the outside world.

[previewyoutube=BdNmf29ECOw;full][/previewyoutube]

If you haven’t already, be sure to check out BrokenLore: LOW, the first chapter of the series, which we released recently.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215569/ac5e68c8f2eeb4826d87569dbfb9376524a9b6a5.png

Follow the BrokenLore series for all the latest updates.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3014520/BrokenLore_LOW/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2846530/BrokenLore_FOLLOW/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2133830/BrokenLore_UNFOLLOW/

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Update - March 5, 2025

Dear players,

We would like to inform you that, due to some exciting news we will be announcing very soon, the release date of our video game has been postponed to April 25, 2025. We are excited to share these new developments with you, which we believe will bring great benefits to the entire series.

Thank you for your continued support and patience.
More details will be shared soon!
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

notes.title: UNFOLLOW 2.0: New Demo Release + New Chapter

This version better reflects the direction we're taking with the game. 
Dive in and let us know what you think! We hope you enjoy it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43601208/cb8e6996530a8973faa7248eef01796af71cecb4.gif

But wait, there's more! Today, we're thrilled to announce that the store page for a new chapter in the BrokenLore story, titled Low, is LIVE on Steam! 🏯 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3014520/BrokenLore_LOW/

This horror game is set in a beautiful Japanese village and delves into the story's origins, taking place 20 years before the events of UNFOLLOW. Don't forget to add it to your wishlist📜

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2849910/Blood_Crossroad/

notes.title: 🌟 FOLLOW: Playtest Access Update! 🌟
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who signed up for early access to FOLLOW demo! We're excited to announce that the playtest has officially begun for some lucky players. A total of 50 individuals now have access to the demo, with more slots opening up next weekend.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911037/b649eaf59ac63bfd1621e49ab127395f0f72f9ad.gif

🎮 You can stream the demo or create video content about it. Help spread the word by encouraging your friends to add our game to their wishlist—it means the world to us!

📆 Stay tuned for updates on the release dates for both UNFOLLOW and FOLLOW. 
We'll announce them as soon as the playtest phase concludes.

notes.title: UNFOLLOW *UPDATED VERSION*
notes.notes:

Update [Beta v0.8.20230207]
- General optimization
- Improvement to the setting
- Add in-game options button
- Adjust inventory
- Balanced the FOV of the character
- Slightly increased walking and running speed
- Modified intro 
- General bug fixes

We can't wait to show you more!
